meta.note: Written by tools/design-system.mjs from the game's code. Change the code, then run npm run design:system.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The near-black outline the existing art uses round characters and bullets, and the rim round a boss's shots. How new art is outlined is Design's call.

tokens.name: warning-red
tokens.usage: Proto Mk0's shots and his turrets' shots, always with a one-pixel outline rim; also the bunker's alarm light and warning marks. Red is kept for warnings in his room.

tokens.name: elite-outline
tokens.usage: Replaces outline on an elite minion. The only thing that tells an elite from its base minion.

tokens.name: player-white
tokens.usage: The player's highlight (key 1 in player.sprite). He is never tinted or recoloured.

tokens.name: ui-text
tokens.usage: HUD and menu lettering, on ui-panel, ui-pad and every room.

tokens.name: ui-panel
tokens.usage: The ground of the pause menu, the level-up cards and the exit question, laid over the game at about 90% opacity; the title screen's ground.

tokens.name: ui-pad
tokens.usage: The touch pads' fill, now fully see-through (17 Oct 2026); also the ground of the dev menu's pop-up.

tokens.name: ui-cyan
tokens.usage: Live and aimed markers, health pips and wheel highlights. A cyan border means a module is running its weapon; a solid cyan bar across its top means the fire button is aimed at it.

tokens.name: ui-gold
tokens.usage: The NEW halo on a weapon a boss just dropped, and nothing else that means new; slots that would take what you hold, and the thin border round each touch pad (at 70%).

tokens.name: ui-frame
tokens.usage: A wheel module frame when that module is not running.

tokens.name: ui-locked
tokens.usage: Fill for anything not yet available (dev mode only: a playtester never sees locked content).

tokens.name: ui-module
tokens.usage: Inside of a wheel module: the black square.

tokens.name: ui-pip-off
tokens.usage: An empty health pip. A full one is ui-cyan.

tokens.name: ui-icon
tokens.usage: Small drawn icons on the controls.

tokens.name: ui-scrim
tokens.usage: The veil behind the re-quip wheel, at 55%.

tokens.name: pickup-etank-primary
tokens.usage: An E-Tank's body as the game draws it today: a 7x7 square in an outline shell.

tokens.name: pickup-etank-secondary
tokens.usage: The cross on an E-Tank. The cross and the EXP bar tell the two apart without colour.

tokens.name: pickup-exp-primary
tokens.usage: An EXP orb's body as the game draws it today.

tokens.name: pickup-exp-secondary
tokens.usage: The bar across an EXP orb.

tokens.name: area-ground
tokens.usage: The ground you stand on between rooms. It must stand apart from every area backdrop by brightness alone, at least 2 : 1, because a pit is only the gap in it (tests/contrast.test.js).

tokens.name: area-cap
tokens.usage: The ground's lit top edge, ground-cap tall: the line that shows where every pit starts. At least 4.5 : 1 against every backdrop, and always in the top ten rows of the ground band, above the thumb pads.

tokens.name: area-platform
tokens.usage: Floating platforms between rooms, read against the backdrop.

tokens.name: area-spike
tokens.usage: Spikes between rooms: a row of silver teeth about 5 pixels wide, spike-height tall.

tokens.name: door-boss
tokens.usage: A boss door that will open: door-width x door-height, standing on the floor.

tokens.name: door-exit
tokens.usage: The exit door that appears in a room when its boss dies: gold-cored, to read as a way out rather than a threat.

tokens.name: door-unarmed
tokens.usage: A door that will not answer yet (it appeared under the player, who has to step off it first), at 55%: no halo, no pulse.

tokens.name: door-halo
tokens.usage: The pulsing edge round a door that will open, two pixels wide.

styles.name: text-1x
styles.usage: Every word in the game: capitals 7 pixels tall, 6 pixels per letter with its gap. Lower case is shown as capitals; a missing character shows as ?.

styles.name: text-2x
styles.usage: The same lettering at twice size. Only whole multiples of 7px stay sharp.

styles.name: text-4x
styles.usage: Four times size, for titles in a design and for reading letter detail.

screen.note: In game pixels. The picture is scaled up by a whole number on the real screen.

tokens.name: screen-height
tokens.usage: The game is always 224 pixels tall.

tokens.name: screen-width-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest screen. Check every design here.

tokens.name: screen-width-max
tokens.usage: Widest screen. Check every design here too.

tokens.name: floor-y
tokens.usage: The floor line: characters stand on it, in the area and in a boss room.

tokens.name: ground-depth
tokens.usage: The ground band below the floor line. The thumb pads cover its lower part, so only its top rows are always in view.

tokens.name: pads-top
tokens.usage: Top of the thumb pads, which cover y 199 to 224: 25 pixels, see-through, each with a thin ui-gold border.

tokens.name: hud-band
tokens.usage: The top band the HUD may use. Keep anything that must be read out of it.

grid.note: Drawing boxes and hit boxes, in game pixels. The drawing is never stretched to fit a hit box.

tokens.name: grid-player
tokens.usage: The player's drawing box, 24 by 24.

tokens.name: grid-minion
tokens.usage: A minion's drawing box; elites share it.

tokens.name: grid-miniboss
tokens.usage: Reserved; nothing uses it yet.

tokens.name: grid-boss
tokens.usage: A boss's drawing box, 48 by 48.

tokens.name: grid-shot
tokens.usage: A bullet's drawing box; the room around the shot is for a glow or a trail.

tokens.name: grid-pickup
tokens.usage: A pickup's drawing box.

tokens.name: hitbox-player-w
tokens.usage: Player hit box width, standing.

tokens.name: hitbox-player-h
tokens.usage: Player hit box height, standing.

tokens.name: hitbox-slide-w
tokens.usage: Player hit box width, sliding.

tokens.name: hitbox-slide-h
tokens.usage: Player hit box height, sliding.

tokens.name: shot-max
tokens.usage: The biggest shot the game draws, as a ball this wide.

tokens.name: pickup-box
tokens.usage: A pickup's pick-up box.

tokens.name: outline-width
tokens.usage: Outline and rim are one pixel.

world.note: The area between boss rooms, in game pixels: what the ground, platforms, spikes and doors are built from. Sizes and collision stay as they are; art changes only the look.

tokens.name: ground-cap
tokens.usage: The ground's lit top edge, the pit edge (area-cap).

tokens.name: pit-width-min
tokens.usage: The narrowest pit.

tokens.name: pit-width-max
tokens.usage: The widest pit, worked out from the jump so every pit can be cleared.

tokens.name: platform-thickness
tokens.usage: A floating platform is this thick.

tokens.name: platform-width-min
tokens.usage: The narrowest platform.

tokens.name: platform-width-max
tokens.usage: The widest platform.

tokens.name: platform-rise-min
tokens.usage: The lowest a platform sits above the floor.

tokens.name: platform-rise-max
tokens.usage: The highest a platform sits, worked out from the jump.

tokens.name: spike-height
tokens.usage: A spike bed is this tall, standing on the floor.

tokens.name: spike-width-min
tokens.usage: The narrowest spike bed.

tokens.name: spike-width-max
tokens.usage: The widest spike bed.

tokens.name: door-width
tokens.usage: A door, boss or exit.

tokens.name: door-height
tokens.usage: A door, standing on the floor.

depth.note: How the game layers things today, back to front; bigger numbers are drawn in front. Not a fixed rule: layering follows ordinary 2D practice (the owner's call, 17 Oct 2026).

tokens.name: depth-background
tokens.usage: The far background.

tokens.name: depth-arena
tokens.usage: A boss room's 16-bit art and furniture.

tokens.name: depth-world
tokens.usage: Ground, spikes, platforms, doors.

tokens.name: depth-pickups
tokens.usage: Pickups.

tokens.name: depth-minions
tokens.usage: Minions.

tokens.name: depth-bullets
tokens.usage: Every bullet.

tokens.name: depth-boss
tokens.usage: The boss.

tokens.name: depth-effects
tokens.usage: A weapon's dust, spikes and sand: over the boss, behind the player.

tokens.name: depth-heldBack
tokens.usage: The weapon in his FAR hand: just behind his body, a quarter darker.

tokens.name: depth-player
tokens.usage: The player.

tokens.name: depth-held
tokens.usage: The weapon in the player's NEAR hand, just in front of his body.

tokens.name: depth-cover
tokens.usage: The Grass boss's ground cover: one layer above the player.

timing.note: In steps, 60 a second. "Frames" in a duration means steps.

tokens.name: steps-per-second
tokens.usage: The game clock: every duration is a whole number of these steps.

tokens.name: beat
tokens.usage: One beat, in steps: two seconds, one bar of Volt Man's 120-beats-a-minute track. His room runs on it.

tokens.name: hold-default
tokens.usage: How long a sprite frame shows when its sheet does not say.

tokens.name: invuln
tokens.usage: The flicker after a hit, in which nothing can hurt the player.

tokens.name: slide-tap
tokens.usage: A second tap of jump inside this many steps slides instead.

tokens.name: warp-out
tokens.usage: The slow fade to black at a boss door.

tokens.name: arrival-room
tokens.usage: A boss room fades in over this.

tokens.name: arrival-furniture
tokens.usage: Then its furniture, over this.

tokens.name: arrival-beam
tokens.usage: Then the boss beams down, over this.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner is square. Pixel art has no rounding.
